events.title: Ruby 1.8 released
events.summary: Matz released [Ruby] 1.8.0 on August 4, 2003 — the stable branch that powered the first Rails era and defined [Ruby] for years.
events.about: [Ruby] 1.8 was the dialect developers used when Rails exploded: blocks, mixins, and `require` gems via RubyGems. Though [Ruby] 0.95 launched the language, 1.8 was the production baseline before 1.9 and the [Ruby] 2/3 performance work.

narrative.whyChosen: [Ruby] 1.8 was the version underneath the first decade of Rails startups.
narrative.whyImportant: Stability and gem ecosystem maturity made [Ruby] a credible web language.
narrative.problemSolved: Earlier [Ruby] branches changed too quickly for frameworks and hosting providers to standardize.
